behavior.nonexact: Delegate unchanged four-slot argv to the original selected static Java reference CAS method.
behavior.exact: Require all three source CP coordinate TYPE IDs to equal the represented receiver/field/field Class identities, then delegate.
behavior.incoming_pending_context: Preserve all 32 bytes and perform no operation.
behavior.null_varhandle: Original invokevirtual receiver check precedes the bridge; direct native fallback is builtin Context4.

scope: One active reference-instance CAS dispatch family. Other VarHandle shapes, static/indexed/primitive families and MethodHandle invocation remain unsupported. No complete game acceptance is implied.
